acceptance.given: Package A validation artifacts define unit, boundary, negative, and CLI integration cases with independent expected results.

oracle.expected: The repository-owned Package A pytest selection exposes an explicit case-to-assertion mapping for every required case, with each mapping retaining its independent expected result.
forbidden: Any required Package A case lacks an explicit assertion mapping
A required case is missing, skipped, deselected, xfailed, or zero-case
A harness error is treated as successful coverage
oracle.observable: Inspection of the Package A mapping artifact and the selected pytest run enumerates all required cases, assertion identities, and expected outcomes.

acceptance.then: Every required Package A case has an explicit case/assertion mapping and independently verifiable expected result.
acceptance.when: Package A validation artifacts are inspected and the repository-owned pytest terminal selection is executed.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the Package A pytest selection and inspect its case/assertion mapping; fail when any required unit, boundary, negative, or CLI integration case lacks an explicit assertion mapping or independent expected result.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Validate that Package A terminal artifacts provide complete explicit mappings from every required case to its assertion and expected result.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema changes; rollback restores the prior Package A validation behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Package A validation moves from defined cases without guaranteed mappings to complete, inspectable case/assertion coverage.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The targeted Package A pytest selection passes only when all required cases are explicitly mapped to assertions with independent expected results; missing, skipped, deselected, xfailed, zero-case, and harness-error conditions fail validation.
